selection: E1a byte-preserving extraction of five static delivery-result clauses (two in entwurf-v2-surface.ts, three in remote-pair-send.ts); the C0 inventory does not cover these modules, so each clause was extracted from the sourceSha blob by two independently written expected files that agreed byte-for-byte before the product JSON was edited; branch conditions, receipt prefixes/suffixes, slots and punctuation stay code-owned

clauses.finalized-rejected: the receiver refused it; nothing was accepted
clauses.dirty-lock: the lock is DIRTY (release failed) — do NOT retry, a re-send would double-deliver. Clear the lock by hand.
clauses.remote-accepted: accepted by the other host (its fact; read/answer unknown until a reply arrives; paths below are on the other host)
clauses.remote-reported-error: the other host reported an error while processing; read its receipt below, delivery is not inferred from this line; not retried (paths below are on the other host)
clauses.remote-indeterminate: The other host may or may not have enqueued; not retried.
